learner.name: Learner
learner.description: Uses the lead weapon, favors visible attack power and buys levels first.

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.description: Reads the game’s damage hints, learns counters and protects repair funds.

planner.name: Planner
planner.description: Uses counters, carried healing, spare sales and sleep between visits; strategy settings are recorded in the run.

investor.name: Investor
investor.description: Prepares counters and defenses, collects Vault returns and releases savings for concrete upgrades.

random.name: Experimenter

saver.name: Saver
saver.description: Hunts one floor below capability, maintains gear and banks between sessions.
